question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Brought to light
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"Brought to light"** means to disclose or reveal something that was previously unknown or hidden. (प्रकाश में लाना)

 

 
• **Example: **The investigation brought to light several new facts about the case.

 

 

 
• **"To disclose" **refers to making known or revealing something that was kept secret or hidden. (प्रकट करना)

 

 
• **Example: **He disclosed his plans to his family only after everything was finalized.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To seem likely **(संभावना प्रतीत होना): Appearing to have a high probability of happening.

 

 
• **Example:** It seems likely that they will win the match.

 

 

 
• **To burn **(जलाना): To be on fire or to set something on fire.

 

 
• **Example: **Be careful not to burn the toast.

 

 

 
• **In favour of** (के पक्ष में): Supporting or approving something.

 

 
• **Example:** She is in favour of the new policy changes.

 

 

41:Tad5,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
